Detaliile colectării și motivele datelor nevalide

Zilele calendaristice nu dovedesc colectare continuă. Comparația include numai orizonturi ajunse la termen; lipsurile rămân necunoscute. Latențele fără intrare includ și intrările refuzate. Mediile folosesc doar rezultate evaluate. Prețurile și cotațiile paper nu confirmă execuția. Rezultatele sunt descriptive, fără dovadă de profitabilitate sau drawdown de portofoliu.

payload.changed_policies: retained in universe, excluded from frozen-policy comparison
payload.cohort: new engine registrations during [declared_at, ends_at); no historical enrollment
payload.control: prospective contract-hash enrollment, excluding selected tokens
payload.costs: original independent paper outcomes, pool and Jupiter kept separate
payload.maturity: signal + frozen entry window + horizon + exit window; same rule for all groups

collection_rules.coverage_reporting: background-coverage-v1; complete cached report with calculation timestamp
collection_rules.execution_order: earliest currently due deadline among admitted unique candidates; stable ties
collection_rules.network_budget_rule: interval minus 5s for finalization; optional enrichment waits share min(30s,interval/4); discovery min(10s,interval/6); markets min(15s,interval/4) per batch
collection_rules.research_reserve_rule: up to max(1,floor(budget/6)) slots after balanced protected followups and discovery, before surplus followups; manual/evidenced-story cadence overrides daily background
collection_rules.route_admission_rule: one quote per candidate dispatch; require time for the full original quote timeout before claiming; defer without a failed attempt
collection_rules.security_early_reserve_rule: ceil(budget/3); single-slot budgets alternate cycles; unused future slots may be borrowed

routed_policy.note: USDC conversion and network fees are configured assumptions. Routes and min outputs are observed quotes, not executed fills. No fallback to estimated pool results.

payload.selection: noncritical alert on the original first baseline only

registration_to_first_evaluation.method: nearest-rank empirical quantiles; receipt timestamps, not exchange execution

discovery_to_alert.method: nearest-rank empirical quantiles; receipt timestamps, not exchange execution

alert_to_display.method: nearest-rank empirical quantiles; receipt timestamps, not exchange execution

export.alert_followup_scope: Descriptive first noncritical alert per newly enrolled token, including later alerts. Separate from the original first-evaluation comparison; no retrospective selection or matched-time control claim.
limitations: Thirty elapsed days do not prove thirty days of continuous collection.
Only new Solana engine registrations are enrolled; feed coverage is partial.
Primary comparisons use the frozen policy, verified source kind and original holdout boundary.
Only conservatively matured horizons enter comparison; unresolved outcomes remain counted.
Evaluated-only means and Wilson intervals are descriptive, not causal evidence or return predictions.
Pool estimates and Jupiter quotes are independent scenarios, not executed trades or one funded portfolio.
A timely price observation is not a successful entry or exit; source trade timestamps may be unavailable.
Later alerts do not retrospectively select an initially rejected token.
